Email.//Provider: Which transport to use: 'Api' (POST to EmailRelay over HTTP — works when SMTP ports are blocked) or 'Smtp' (direct, port 587).

Smtp.//Username: Set via user-secrets (dev) or env var Smtp__Username (prod).
Smtp.//Password: Set via user-secrets (dev) or env var Smtp__Password (prod).

EmailApi.//Url: URL of the EmailRelay /api/send endpoint hosted where SMTP works.
EmailApi.//ApiKey: Shared secret — must match Relay:ApiKey on the EmailRelay. Set here or via env var EmailApi__ApiKey.
